description: HAZA-48 - Using Geodetic Remote Sensing to Measure and Model the Impacts of Gas Extraction from the Surat Basin, Australia is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) is a proven geodetic imaging technique that makes use of remotely sensed radar imagery to map spatial patterns of ground surface movement and their temporal evolution. One application of the InSAR technique is to monitor human interactions with the landscape, such as the extraction of resources from the crust. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data.
